chapters.title: Following one defect through a hypothetical plant
Who owns which decision: ERP, MES and quality
Modeling the quality case in Dataverse
Capturing defects at the machine with Power Apps
ERP and MES integration and root cause investigation
Corrective action, disposition, reporting and rollout

takeaways: A submitted defect form controls nothing by itself; the workflow must carry each decision from an authorized person to the team and system that enforces it, such as holds in the ERP or MES.

Model containment, correction, corrective action and disposition as separate records and states in Dataverse, and enforce protected transitions server-side instead of relying on Power Apps form logic.
Close a CAPA only on evidence: confirmed ERP and MES results, reconciled material quantities and an effectiveness review against criteria agreed before the results were collected.
hook: A defect becomes expensive when nobody knows who owns the next action after an inspector submits a quality form. This episode is for quality managers, Power Platform makers and manufacturing IT teams designing nonconformance and CAPA workflows. You will learn how to use Power Apps, Dataverse and Power Automate to carry a defect from capture through containment, ERP and MES integration to verified corrective action.
